data.name: Alternate Kelvin and Virginia Outfits
data.shortDescription: Adds alternate hidden Virginia & Kelvin Outfits and customization for use  in the game.
data.description:
There are few hidden outfits that are normally not accessible in the game directly. This mod adds those outfits for use within the config settings. Additionally it gives you the option to customize some of the already existing outfit pieces to mix and match to a degree. The new outfits this game adds are as follows:

Kelvin:

-Golden Armor
-Priest Outfit.

Virginia:

-Red Dress
-White Dress

Additional customization options:

-Can now enable the sunglasses on Kelvin regardless of outfit.
-Can now enable all of Virginia's shoes except her dress shoes on any outfit.
-Can also disable any shoes regardless of outfit.

Credits: 
Special thanks to Shoko for teaching me how to enable and disable game objects.
